status_history.owner_words: Owner placed the file in docs/marketing/approved-creative-examples/auction/ as a good example of creative work.

source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.event_date_visible: Sunday June 28 · 11 AM · In-house or online

classification.event_product_type: Category auction (watches and fine jewellery) with in-house and online bidding

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Right column: crest → seller name → FINE TIMEPIECES (gold) → AUCTION (very large navy) → brand list → three icon rows (calendar, in-house/online, address) → navy CTA bar → gold footer bar. Left 55%: five photo tiles of watches and jewellery.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Rectangular product-photo tiles (diamond Rolex, Cartier, Breitling, Bulgari, jade heart pendant with Cartier bracelet) separated by thin white gutters. Source backgrounds retained (clean marble/cream), not extracted. Every dial and clasp fully visible.
visual_read.composition_style: Grid + information panel. Orderly, catalogue-like; no overlap.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Spaced serif caps; AUCTION dominates; gold icon discs introduce each information row; brand names in a bulleted line.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller crest and name at the top of the panel; URL repeated twice (CTA bar and footer bar) plus social icons.
visual_read.cta_treatment: Navy bar 'VIEW THE VIDEO PREVIEW at LMAUCTIONCO.COM' — a factual CTA pointing to a real asset.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Gold band with the URL and Facebook/Instagram icons, spanning the information column only.
visual_read.photographic_style: Macro product photography on marble; sharp, evenly lit.

strongest_attributes: Luxury product photography carries the ad even with a dense information column
Icon-led logistics rows (date, mode, address) make high density scannable
Brand names as the sell for a category auction (Rolex, Cartier, Breitling, Bulgari)
Dials, bezels and clasps — the identifying details — are never cropped or overlapped
transferable_lessons: For category auctions where facts are the draw (brands, in-house/online, address), a denser icon-led logistics block is acceptable provided merchandise still holds at least half the canvas
Tiled product photography is a legitimate merchandise treatment for small luxury objects where extraction adds nothing
Protected-region discipline: watch dials fully visible (validates the 3M protected-region rule)
Video preview CTA is factual when a real preview exists
do_not_generalize: Gold/navy/cream palette, crest, gold icon discs — seller identity
Seller address, phone and social handles
Repeating the URL twice — Advantage.Bid uses the single footer wordmark
Eight copy blocks — over the Advantage.Bid general budget; acceptable only in a category/logistics family with an explicit larger budget

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: The density is organised: one column, icon-introduced rows, one dominant word. It reads as a programme, not clutter.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Proposes a family-scoped budget: CATEGORY_GROUP with logistics may carry up to 7 blocks; general families stay at 5.

composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Tiles roughly equal; the diamond Rolex gets the largest tile top-left (the eye's entry point).
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Tiles bleed to the left and top edges; the panel is contained.

use_cases: events with logistics to communicate (in-house + online, address)

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
